FrTitle: SessionLogs missing AgentSession columns fail closed
FrBody: After host start, sessionlog query never fails with SQL Invalid column name for AgentSessionId, AgentSessionTranscriptFile, AgentExecutablePath, or AgentExecutableVersion. Missing schema fails closed as pending-migration. Provider migrations apply the four columns on every host workspace database: Sqlite 20260818205751_AddSessionLogTagsAndAgentSessionHeaders, SqlServer 20260818205807_AddSessionLogTagsAndAgentSessionHeaders, Postgres 20260818205822_AddSessionLogTagsAndAgentSessionHeaders.

TrTitle: Startup probe for AgentSession header columns

TestCondition: A fixture database missing the four agent header columns fails closed with pending-migration. After Sqlite MigrateAsync applies 20260818205751_AddSessionLogTagsAndAgentSessionHeaders on a legacy SessionLogs table (with or without SessionLogTags), sessionlog query with and without text filter succeeds. SqlServer 20260818205807 and Postgres 20260818205822 Up() add the same columns; live MigrateAsync for those providers requires a server host.
